name: XasmEventDispatch Main
brief: Dependent half of the cross-assembly event-dispatch reproducer: fires the dep app's codeunit event while the dep's subscriber codeunit type exists in two loaded assemblies.
description: Runs as bundle 2 after xasm-event-dispatch-dep ran as bundle 1. The dep app is now loaded TWICE (bundle 1's emit + this bundle's dep compile), so the codeunit-event registry holds the same AL subscriber from two assemblies. RED: MethodInfo.Invoke on an instance from the other assembly → TargetException 'Object does not match target type' (the exact failure that aborted Pageworks.Test's SPBLIC OnInstallAppPerDatabase → CU9999.OnGetPerCompanyUpgradeTags chain), or a double-fire. GREEN: exactly one increment, no TargetException.
